answer.rationale: Write-path p99 is climbing and confined to the primary region, while the security patch release cannot be reverted and settlement writes are heavy. Regional failover has a verified precedent (b2) showing traffic shifts cleanly and error rates recover within minutes without losing customer writes. A release rollback (b1) is blocked by the compliance ruling on the security patch. Adding capacity, enabling circuit breakers, or routing reads to replicas do not directly relieve write-path latency under peak settlement load. One intervention only: failover to the secondary region to restore sustained availability while preserving all in-flight writes via the standard failover path.
